banner_headline: RBI Raises Boil Rate; Rupee-Cup Slips Against Filter Coffee

hero_photo.scene: The Reserve Brew of India governor solemnly pouring chai from a great height into a steel tumbler before a wall of reporters holding empty kulhads.
hero_photo.caption: Governor Shaktikanta Dum demonstrates the new 'long pour' policy to cool an overheated economy.
hero_photo.secret: He spilled 40 cups of GDP on his kurta; the photographer was tipped two sips to crop it.

stories.headline: New Market Bakery Strike Enters Day 9 Over 'Lukewarm Wages'
stories.text: Workers at Sharma Toast & Rusk, New Market, refuse to bake until salaries arrive above 70°C. 'By the time payroll reaches us, a skin has formed,' said union head Pappu Malviya. Management blames a faulty thermos fleet. With no rusk to dunk, economists warn the city's savings are being drunk dangerously fast.

photo.scene: Bakers in aprons holding placards beside a cold tandoor and a row of sealed thermoses.
photo.caption: Strikers demand wages 'garam, not just declared garam.'
photo.secret: The placard reading 'No Skin In The Game' was the reporter's idea.

stories.headline: Counterfeit Ring Busted: 400 Litres of Watered-Down Currency Seized
stories.text: Police raided a godown near Hamidia Road where a gang was diluting cutting chai with tap water and reused leaves. 'The elaichi was merely a suggestion,' said SP Rekha Tomar, visibly shaken. Three arrested; one tried to drink the evidence. Citizens are urged to check notes for proper colour, not 'that sad beige.'

photo.scene: Police officers standing sternly behind a table of confiscated kettles and suspiciously pale glasses of chai.
photo.caption: The seized funds, described by officers as 'an insult to both law and ginger.'
photo.secret: Two glasses went missing between the raid and this photo. Nobody is investigating.

stories.headline: Widower Still Keeps Wife's Last Cup in Lake View Bank Locker
stories.text: Every Sunday, retired clerk Ramesh Shrivastava, 81, visits locker 114 to look at one cold cup his wife Sudha poured in 2009. It has no value now; tellers say it evaporated to a brown ring years ago. 'She put in too much sugar,' he says. 'I never told her. I'm not spending it.'

photo.scene: An elderly man in a sweater vest sitting on a bank bench, holding a small steel glass with both hands.
photo.caption: Shrivastava with locker 114's sole deposit.
photo.secret: The bank quietly waived his locker fee eleven years ago and still sends him the bill marked 'paid.'

sports.headline: Bhopal Boilers Win After Tea Break Declared Illegal Mid-Match Spending

classifieds: WANTED: Night guard for kettle vault, Arera Colony. Must not be thirsty. Previous three were.
FOR SALE: Piggy bank, ceramic, slight leak. Lost my life savings on the carpet. 2 cups or best offer.
MATRIMONIAL: Groom, 29, MP Nagar, earns 600 cups/month, strong brew. Seeks bride; adrak-compatible families only.
letter_to_editor: Sir, my son's pocket money has been spent before reaching school for six years running. He says it is 'inflation.' I say it is a moustache of evidence. Kindly advise. — Mrs. Nirmala Jain, Kohefiza
